messages.text: Explicit extensions are fixed. I’m checking the API endpoint again on the fresh port.

commands.commandLine: "C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$out=Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'start-out.log'; "'$err=Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'start-err.log'; Remove-Item "'$out,$err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $p = Start-Process -FilePath npm.cmd -ArgumentList @('"'run','start') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location) -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput "'$out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; try { if (!$p.HasExited) { (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:43123/api/marketplace -UseBasicParsing).StatusCode } } finally { if (!$p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } }; Get-Content $out -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-Content $err -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue'
